# Cloak

> Private trading on Elysium (testnet), built on Gloam's shielded vault: sealed-bid token launches, and trades, sends and withdrawals from a private balance, proven locally and sent by a relayer.

AI agents: read https://oncloak.xyz/agent.md and follow it. It sets you up and says what to ask the person.

- [Every rule, with its number](https://oncloak.xyz/docs#rules)
